(Hikita–Nakajima conjecture).

Let $X,X^{!}$ be symplectically dual, and denote by $\mathcal{A}$ the universal quantization of $X$ . Then there exist

•

an isomorphism between the quantization exact sequence
${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces 0}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces H_{2}(X)\oplus k\hbar}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces\mathcal{A}_{0}^{2}}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces\mathfrak{t}}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces 0}$
and the cohomology exact sequence
${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces 0}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces H^{2}_{T^{!}\times\mathbb{G}_{m}}(\mathrm{pt})}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces H^{2}_{T^{!}\times\mathbb{G}_{m}}(X^{!})}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces H^{2}(X^{!})}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces 0.}$
of $k$ -vector spaces, together with

•

an isomorphism of graded and commutative $H^{2}_{T^{!}\times\mathbb{G}_{m}}(\mathrm{pt})\cong k[H_{2}(X)][\hbar]$ -algebras

(2.20)

$B(\mathcal{A})\cong H^{*}_{T^{!}\times\mathbb{G}_{m}}(X^{!};k),$

which specializes to the isomorphism predicted by the Hikita conjecture.

In particular, Conjecture 2.32 predicts an isomorphisms $H^{2}(X)\cong\mathfrak{t}^{!}$ and $\mathfrak{t}\cong H^{2}(X^{!})$ (the identification of equivariant and Kähler parameters). Also note that $B(\mathcal{A})$ is not a priori commutative, but the existence of the isomorphism with the commutative $H^{*}_{T^{!}\times\mathbb{G}_{m}}(X^{!};k)$ implies that the ring structure is in fact commutative.
card.label: Conjecture 2.32

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
